text: dsh-graft-plugin 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的代码图谱插件。它在会话输入框显示当前工作区 Graft 索引的状态，并提供图谱可视化入口。模型可使用五个工具搜索代码、查找调用关系、查看文件接口和浏览目录结构；用户也能用 /graft 创建、重建或检查索引。文件变更后插件会自动安排重建，适合需要在 DSH 会话中理解大型代码库的开发者。需安装 graft CLI。

dsh-graft-plugin adds Graft code graphs to DSH web sessions. A composer chip shows index status and opens the graph. Five model tools search code, trace callers, inspect file APIs, and map directories. Use /graft to build or check an index; edits can trigger rebuilding. Requires graft CLI.
想让 DSH 帮我快速弄清一个代码仓库的结构。
有没有办法在聊天时搜索项目代码并看到相关行？
我想查一个函数都被哪些地方调用。
让 DSH 在我改完代码后自动更新代码索引。
能不能在 DSH 里看当前项目的代码图谱和索引状态？
Help me understand how symbols and files connect in this codebase.
I need to find every occurrence of a pattern in the indexed source.
Can my coding assistant refresh its code graph after edits?
该插件的功能「代码搜索」：模型用自然语言查询预构建的代码图谱，并获得排序结果及对应源码行；可选返回完整代码片段。
该插件的功能「调用关系追踪」：输入符号名即可查询调用者、被调用项或指定深度的关联范围，帮助理解符号依赖。
该插件的功能「图谱状态」：会话输入框显示工作区图谱的节点数、边数及同步新鲜度，并提供打开可视化图谱的入口。
该插件的功能「/graft 命令」：输入 /graft 构建或重建索引，/graft status 查看状态，/graft deep 执行深度构建。
该插件的功能「自动重建」：成功的文件写入或编辑会标记图谱待更新，并在编辑暂停或回合结束时触发同步重建。
dsh-graft-plugin README · Introduction：

dsh-graft-plugin README · dsh-graft-plugin：English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts [graft](https://github.com/trailhq/Graft) — a prebuilt graph of every symbol, its `file:line` span, and who calls what — in front of both you and the model.

It does four things:

dsh-graft-plugin README · dsh-graft-plugin：- **A chip in the composer** naming the graft index the current session is actually serving, whether it still matches the code, and how many tokens graft has saved in that repo. Its card carries a **Build** button — rebuild the index, or create the first one.
- **Five tools for the model** — `graft_ask`, `graft_grep`, `graft_callers`, `graft_skeleton`, `graft_map` — resolved per session, so one dsh can serve several workspaces at once, git worktrees included, each with its own graph.
- **`/graft`** to build or rebuild the index, and **auto-rebuild** after the model edits files.
- **A `graft viz` button** that opens the graph in dsh's built-in right sidebar (0.1.5+), in [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) if you still run it, and in a browser tab as the last resort.

dsh-graft-plugin README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-graft-plugin
dsh --profile web
```

**pnpm 10 and later block `postinstall` scripts from unapproved packages**, and dsh skips writing the plugin's bundle row whenever the install exits non-zero — the dependency lands, the plugin stays invisible, and dsh starts up cleanly with no error to search for. If `add` ends with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, approve and re-run it:

dsh-graft-plugin README · Install：```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm approve-builds      # tick dsh-graft-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-graft-plugin      # re-run so the bundle row gets written
```

Confirm it mounted — the plugin must appear in **both** `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`:

dsh-graft-plugin README · Install：```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && node -e "const p=require('./package.json');
  console.log(p.dependencies['dsh-graft-plugin'],
              p.dsh.profile.bundles.includes('dsh-graft-plugin'))"
```

Every tool here shells out to the `graft` CLI, so it needs `@nanonets/graft` on PATH:

```sh
npm install -g @nanonets/graft
```

dsh-graft-plugin README · Install：A `postinstall` does this for you **when your package manager runs lifecycle scripts** — under pnpm 10+ they are blocked by default, so treat the command above as the required step there, not a fallback. If your global npm prefix needs elevation, the postinstall says so and prints the one command to run by hand.

Then index a repo once:

```sh
cd <your repo>
graft build
```

dsh-graft-plugin README · In the desktop app：The desktop dsh installs plugins from its own **Plugins** settings — no CLI, no profile directory:

1. Open **Plugins** (settings, left sidebar) and click **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the GitHub repository address into the field (the package name `dsh-graft-plugin` works too):

```
   https://github.com/adithyanraj03/dsh-graft-plugin
   ```

3. Click **Install**.

The dialog switches to the **Installed** confirmation, and the plugin appears under **Installed** at the bottom of the settings page:

dsh-graft-plugin README · In the desktop app：> The dialog notes that installed plugins **do not update automatically yet** — to upgrade, uninstall and install again. The graft CLI requirement (`npm install -g @nanonets/graft`) is the same.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The sidebar tab：On dsh `0.1.5` and later the button opens the graph in **dsh's own right sidebar** — a tab titled Graft, also listed on the sidebar's guide page as "The graft graph for this workspace" — and a second click focuses the tab that is already open. No install needed for that path: the registration is soft, so an older dsh without the right sidebar falls through to `dsh-better-sidebar` when it is mounted, and to a browser tab when neither is there.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The sidebar tab：If your profile still runs `dsh-better-sidebar`, that path is tried **first** and behaves exactly as before. From 0.3.0 it is an **optional peer dependency** — dsh no longer downloads it for you, so add it yourself when you want it (on dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` or later it cannot mount anyway, so most profiles should skip this):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
```

dsh-graft-plugin README · The sidebar tab：> **Compatibility.** `dsh-better-sidebar` 0.18.x requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, which dsh removed in `0.1.5-rc.2`. On that version or later it will not mount — which is exactly the profiles where the built-in right sidebar takes over instead. Everything else in this plugin — chip, tools, `/graft`, auto-rebuild — is unaffected.
dsh-graft-plugin README · The sidebar tab：The chip, the tools, `/graft` and the auto-rebuild all work without any sidebar; the button simply falls back to a browser tab when neither one is present.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The sidebar tab：> This plugin does **not** insert a `dsh-better-sidebar` row itself, on purpose. That package's own bundle row carries a guard that disables it when another enabled row already mounts the same package. A second row with a different id makes that guard circular, and the losing outcome is *your existing sidebar silently disabling itself*. One explicit command is worth more than that risk.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The chip：Sits in the composer next to the model name:

```
● graft · my-repo          in sync
◐ graft · my-repo          syncing
▲ graft · my-repo          stale
```

Hovering (or clicking) opens a card with the resolved root, node and edge counts, freshness, the running saved-token tally, and the `graft viz` button.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The chip：The card's header carries a **Build** button beside the status pill. In a repo that already has an index it runs the same rebuild the auto-rebuild runs — graft's own sync — and holds "Building…" until the pill reads *in sync*, giving up after two minutes and showing the reason. In a workspace with no index yet, Build first asks in dsh's own dialog ("Build graft index?" — Cancel / Build index; Cancel, Escape or clicking outside builds nothing), then runs a plain offline `graft build`, which writes a `graft/` directory there.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The chip：While a `graft_*` tool is running, the chip's dot blinks violet.

Chip, card and viz tab are painted with dsh's own `--dsw-*` theme variables, so they follow the active theme — including theme plugins.

A linked git worktree gets its own graph, never the main checkout's: the card and the viz bar name the main checkout it belongs to (`git worktree of <repo>`). With no graph yet, `/graft` in the worktree seeds the first one from it.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The chip：The root is resolved from **the session's own workspace**, not from wherever dsh was launched. That is the whole reason this exists rather than the `graft mcp` server: `graft mcp` resolves its repo once, from its own working directory at startup, and nothing can re-point it afterwards. Launched from a home directory it answers *"no graph found"* for every workspace you open.

dsh-graft-plugin README · The visualiser：The `graft viz` button opens the graph as a tab — in dsh's built-in right sidebar on `0.1.5`+, in [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) if that is what you run. The context view lays out the whole graph:

The code view drills into a single file — what it contains, what it depends on, what depends on it:

dsh-graft-plugin README · The tools：| tool | what it answers |
|---|---|
| `graft_ask` | "how does X work" / "where is Y" — ranked hits with code inlined at exact `file:line` |
| `graft_grep` | every occurrence, grouped by enclosing symbol (`graft_ask` is top-N and misses some) |
| `graft_callers` | who calls a symbol, what it calls, or the full blast radius before a rename |
| `graft_skeleton` | a file's whole API in ~200 tokens |
| `graft_map` | orientation in an unfamiliar tree |

dsh-graft-plugin README · The tools：None of them take a boolean parameter. They take string enums instead — `detail: "full"` rather than `full: true` — which reads better to a model and sidesteps a real failure mode on some OpenAI-compatible servers, where a tool call that *sets* a boolean is emitted as literal `<tool_call>` text and never runs.

dsh-graft-plugin README · `/graft`：- `/graft` — build the index, or rebuild it if one exists
- `/graft status` — what the chip knows, as text
- `/graft deep` — a full rebuild

dsh-graft-plugin README · Auto-rebuild：After the model writes or edits files, the index is rebuilt in the background, debounced so a long turn does not rebuild on every keystroke. This reuses graft's own sync runner rather than reimplementing it, so it cannot drift from what `graft build` does.

dsh-graft-plugin README · Configuration：All optional, all on the plugin's row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: graft-status
  name: 'dsh-graft-plugin'
  config:
    cwd: 'C:/path/to/repo'   # pin to one repo instead of resolving per session

dsh-graft-plugin README · Requirements：| dsh | status |
|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | test suites pass against the `0.2.1-rc.2` packages — chip, tools, `/graft`, auto-rebuild and the model-facing guidance; the dual-shape codecs load on both 0.1 and 0.2 hosts |
| `0.1.7-rc.2` | tested on a live profile (0.3.0) — chip, tools, `/graft`, auto-rebuild and the model-facing guidance all verified |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` – `0.1.0-rc.7` | tested, full feature set — the `graft viz` tab via `dsh-better-sidebar` |
| `0.1.5-rc.2` / `0.1.5` | tested — chip, tools, `/graft` and auto-rebuild all work; on `0.1.5` the `graft viz` button opens the graph in the built-in right sidebar |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | needs plugin `0.2.1`+ — earlier releases fail to activate (see Troubleshooting) |

dsh-graft-plugin README · Requirements：- Node 22+
- the `graft` CLI on PATH (`npm install -g @nanonets/graft`). A bun global install (`bun add -g @nanonets/graft`) is detected too, via `$BUN_INSTALL` or `~/.bun`.

The client bundle requires only `react`, which is why it survives the dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` client-package removals that broke several neighbouring plugins.

dsh-graft-plugin README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test           # portable: builds a synthetic graft index in a temp dir
npm run test:live  # drives the real graft CLI against a real repo
```

`npm test` needs no graft index and no graft install anywhere on the machine. The one suite that does build a real index skips itself, loudly, when graft is absent — a missing CLI is a setup state, not a defect.

dsh-graft-plugin README · Two identifiers, deliberately different：The cordis row `id` (`graft-status`) is this plugin's own handle — it keys the storage file, the prompt section and every effect label, and is stable across renames.

dsh-graft-plugin README · Two identifiers, deliberately different：The client bundle's `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` is **not** that handle. It must be the published package name: dsh builds each client row from `entry.options.name` — the `name:` in `cordis.patch.yml` — serves the bundle at `/plugins/<name>/client.js`, then asserts that a factory registered under that same name. Using the row id there fails every boot with:

```
bundle /plugins/dsh-graft-plugin/client.js loaded without
registering "dsh-graft-plugin" via __ModuleLoader__.load
```
dsh-graft-plugin README · Two identifiers, deliberately different：`npm test` guards this both ways (the guard was added with the 0.1.1 fix).

dsh-graft-plugin README · Troubleshooting：**No chip appears and dsh started without errors.** The plugin is in the profile's `package.json` `dependencies` but not in `dsh.profile.bundles` — which happens under pnpm 10+ when the `add` ends non-zero on `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`; dsh skips the bundle row in that case and starts up looking healthy. Fix: `pnpm approve-builds` in the profile directory (tick `dsh-graft-plugin`), then re-run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-graft-plugin`. If `pnpm approve-builds` reports nothing awaiting approval, check `pnpm-workspace.yaml` for an unanswered `dsh-graft-plugin` entry (pnpm's approval placeholder) and set its value to `true` first.

dsh-graft-plugin README · Troubleshooting：**On dsh 0.2 the plugin fails to load with `strict codec has no create() factory`, and dsh offers to remove it.** dsh 0.2 requires every strict remote codec to carry a `create()` schema factory; plugin releases before `0.2.1` only had the 0.1 `schema` key. Update to `0.2.1` or later, which carries both and so loads on 0.1 and 0.2.

**`/graft` says the graft CLI is not on PATH.** The postinstall was blocked or skipped (see Install): `npm install -g @nanonets/graft`.
dsh-graft-plugin README · Introduction：

dsh-graft-plugin README · dsh-graft-plugin：[English](README.md) | 中文

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，把 [graft](https://github.com/trailhq/Graft)——一张预先构建的符号图（每个符号的 `file:line` 位置、谁调用了谁）——同时摆到你和模型面前。

它做四件事：

dsh-graft-plugin README · dsh-graft-plugin：- **输入框里的徽章（chip）**：说出当前会话实际在用哪个 graft 索引、它是否还与代码一致、这个仓库里 graft 已经省了多少 token。徽章的卡片上有一个 **Build** 按钮——重建索引，或者创建第一个索引。
- **给模型五个工具** — `graft_ask`、`graft_grep`、`graft_callers`、`graft_skeleton`、`graft_map`——按会话解析，所以一个 dsh 可以同时服务多个工作区，git worktree 也不例外，每个都有自己的图。
- **`/graft`** 构建或重建索引，模型改完文件后**自动重建**。
- **`graft viz` 按钮**：在 dsh 内置的右侧边栏（0.1.5+）打开图；如果你还在用 [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)，就在那里打开；两者都没有时退到浏览器标签页。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-graft-plugin
dsh --profile web
```

**pnpm 10 及以后会默认拦截未批准包的 `postinstall` 脚本**，而只要安装以非零退出，dsh 就会跳过写入插件的 bundle 行——依赖装上了，插件却隐形，dsh 还启动得干干净净，没有任何可搜索的报错。如果 `add` 以 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` 结尾，先批准再重跑：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm approve-builds      # 勾选 dsh-graft-plugin
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-graft-plugin      # 重跑，让 bundle 行写入
```

确认它挂载了——插件必须同时出现在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里：

dsh-graft-plugin README · 安装：```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && node -e "const p=require('./package.json');
  console.log(p.dependencies['dsh-graft-plugin'],
              p.dsh.profile.bundles.includes('dsh-graft-plugin'))"
```

这里的每个工具都要调用 `graft` CLI，所以 PATH 上必须有 `@nanonets/graft`：

```sh
npm install -g @nanonets/graft
```

`postinstall` 会在**你的包管理器愿意运行生命周期脚本时**替你装好——pnpm 10+ 默认拦截它们，所以在 pnpm 下请把上面这条命令当作必需步骤，而不是后备。若全局 npm 前缀需要提权，postinstall 会说明并打印那条需要手动执行的命令。

然后给仓库建一次索引：

```sh
cd <your repo>
graft build
```

dsh-graft-plugin README · 桌面应用：桌面版 dsh 从自己的 **Plugins** 设置页安装插件——不用 CLI，不用 profile 目录：

1. 打开 **Plugins**（设置页左侧栏），点 **Add plugin**。
2. 把 GitHub 仓库地址粘进输入框（包名 `dsh-graft-plugin` 也可以）：

```
   https://github.com/adithyanraj03/dsh-graft-plugin
   ```

3. 点 **Install**。

对话框会切换到 **Installed** 确认页，插件同时出现在设置页底部的 **Installed** 列表里：

> 对话框也提示：已安装的插件**目前不会自动更新**——升级请先卸载再重装。graft CLI 的要求（`npm install -g @nanonets/graft`）不变。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 侧边栏标签页：在 dsh `0.1.5` 及以后，这个按钮会在 **dsh 自己的右侧边栏**里打开图——一个名为 Graft 的标签页，同时列在边栏引导页里，说明是 "The graft graph for this workspace"——再次点击会聚焦已打开的标签页。这条路径不需要安装任何东西：注册是软性的，所以没有右侧边栏的旧版 dsh 会退到已挂载的 `dsh-better-sidebar`，两者都没有时退到浏览器标签页。

如果你的 profile 还在用 `dsh-better-sidebar`，会**优先**尝试那条路径，行为和以前完全一样。从 0.3.0 起它是**可选对等依赖（optional peer dependency）**——dsh 不再替你下载，想要就自己加（在 dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` 及以后它本来就挂不起来，多数 profile 可以跳过）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
```

dsh-graft-plugin README · 侧边栏标签页：> **兼容性。** `dsh-better-sidebar` 0.18.x 需要 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，而 dsh 在 `0.1.5-rc.2` 移除了它。在该版本及以后它挂不起来——那些 profile 正好由内置右侧边栏接管。本插件其余部分——徽章、工具、`/graft`、自动重建——都不受影响。

徽章、工具、`/graft` 和自动重建在完全没有侧边栏时也都工作；按钮只是在两个都没有时退到浏览器标签页。

> 这个插件**故意不**自己插入 `dsh-better-sidebar` 行。那个包自己的 bundle 行带一个守卫：当已有另一个启用的行挂载同一个包时，它会自我禁用。第二条不同 id 的行会让这个守卫变成循环判断，输掉的那一边是*你现有的边栏悄悄自我禁用*。一条显式命令比这个风险值钱。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 徽章：待在输入框里模型名的旁边：

```
● graft · my-repo          in sync
◐ graft · my-repo          syncing
▲ graft · my-repo          stale
```

悬停（或点击）打开一张卡片：解析出的根目录、节点与边数、新鲜度、累计省下的 token，以及 `graft viz` 按钮。

卡片头部在状态胶囊旁边有一个 **Build** 按钮。在已有索引的仓库里，它跑的就是自动重建用的那套同步——graft 自己的 sync——并停在 "Building…" 直到胶囊显示 *in sync*，两分钟后放弃并给出原因。在还没有索引的工作区里，Build 会先用 dsh 自己的对话框确认（"Build graft index?" — Cancel / Build index；取消、Escape 或点框外都不会构建），然后跑一次纯离线的 `graft build`，在那里写出一个 `graft/` 目录。

`graft_*` 工具运行期间，徽章的圆点会闪紫色。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 徽章：徽章、卡片和可视化标签页全部用 dsh 自己的 `--dsw-*` 主题变量绘制，因此跟随当前主题——包括主题插件。

链接的 git worktree 拥有自己的图，绝不借用主检出（main checkout）的：卡片和边栏标签条都会标出它所属的主检出（`git worktree of <repo>`）。还没有图时，在 worktree 里 `/graft` 会从主检出播种出第一张图。

根目录是从**会话自己的工作区**解析的，不是从 dsh 的启动位置。这正是本插件存在、而不是用 `graft mcp` 服务器的原因：`graft mcp` 在启动时从自己的工作目录解析一次仓库，之后没有任何办法改指。从主目录启动时，它对你打开的每个工作区都回答*"no graph found"*。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 可视化：`graft viz` 按钮把图作为一个标签页打开——在 `0.1.5`+ 的 dsh 内置右侧边栏里，或者在你仍在使用的 [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) 里。上下文视图铺开整张图：

代码视图下钻到单个文件——它包含什么、依赖什么、被谁依赖：

dsh-graft-plugin README · 工具：| 工具 | 回答什么 |
|---|---|
| `graft_ask` | "X 是怎么工作的" / "Y 在哪"——带排序的命中，代码直接内联在精确的 `file:line` |
| `graft_grep` | 每一处出现，按所在符号分组（`graft_ask` 只给 top-N，会漏） |
| `graft_callers` | 谁调用一个符号、它调用谁，或改名前的完整爆炸半径 |
| `graft_skeleton` | 一个文件的完整 API，约 200 token |
| `graft_map` | 在陌生目录树里定位方向 |

它们都不接受布尔参数，而是用字符串枚举——`detail: "full"` 而不是 `full: true`——对模型更好读，也绕开了一些 OpenAI 兼容服务器上的一个真实故障：*设置*了布尔值的工具调用会被发成字面的 `<tool_call>` 文本，永远不执行。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 自动重建：模型写入或编辑文件后，索引在后台重建，并做了防抖，长回合不会每次击键都重建。这里复用 graft 自己的 sync runner，而不是重新实现一遍，所以它不会和 `graft build` 的行为漂移。

客户端 bundle 只依赖 `react`——这就是它能在 dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` 移除一批客户端包、弄坏了好几个相邻插件的情况下存活的原因。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 开发：```sh
npm install
npm test           # 可移植：在临时目录里构建一个合成的 graft 索引
npm run test:live  # 用真实 graft CLI 对着真实仓库跑
```

`npm test` 不需要任何 graft 索引，机器上也不需要装 graft。唯一会真建索引的那个套件在 graft 缺失时会大声地自我跳过——缺 CLI 是一种环境状态，不是缺陷。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 两个标识符，故意不同：cordis 行的 `id`（`graft-status`）是本插件自己的把手——它键控存储文件、prompt 区块和每个 effect 标签，并且在改名中保持稳定。

客户端 bundle 的 `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` **不是**那个把手。它必须是已发布的包名：dsh 用 `entry.options.name`——即 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `name:`——构建每条客户端行，把 bundle 服务在 `/plugins/<name>/client.js`，然后断言有一个以同一名字注册的工厂。在那里用行 id 会让每次启动都失败：

```
bundle /plugins/dsh-graft-plugin/client.js loaded without
registering "dsh-graft-plugin" via __ModuleLoader__.load
```

`npm test` 双向守着这一点（这个守卫随 0.1.1 的修复加入）。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 故障排查：**徽章没出现，而 dsh 启动毫无报错。** 插件在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里，却不在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里——pnpm 10+ 下 `add` 以 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` 非零退出时就是这样：dsh 跳过 bundle 行，启动看起来一切正常。修法：在 profile 目录里 `pnpm approve-builds`（勾选 `dsh-graft-plugin`），然后重跑 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-graft-plugin`。如果 `pnpm approve-builds` 说没有待批准的包，去 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里找未回答的 `dsh-graft-plugin` 条目（pnpm 的批准占位符），先把它的值改成 `true`。

dsh-graft-plugin README · 故障排查：**在 dsh 0.2 上插件加载失败，报 `strict codec has no create() factory`，dsh 还提议移除它。** dsh 0.2 要求每个 strict remote codec 都带一个 `create()` schema 工厂；`0.2.1` 之前的插件发行版只有 0.1 的 `schema` 键。升级到 `0.2.1` 或更新版本——它两种都带，0.1 和 0.2 上都能加载。

**`/graft` 说 graft CLI 不在 PATH 上。** postinstall 被拦截或被跳过了（见安装）：`npm install -g @nanonets/graft`。
